title: service-analytics: the native-SQL face emits plain LIKE for mssql, so a dashboard's text filter on a SQL Server federated object does not keep #6518's case-exact / case-folded contract the driver keeps
body:
epic:#27261#1 · marchtian · session_017ihL2c5z3q4h8inrn5kwqV
Filing gate: ③ escalation of the CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER record on PR #31381 (#31327). #6518's text-match contract holds on the driver face only.
Ruling-ref: #6518 (case-exact and case-folded text match)
Dedupe (open AND closed): "analytics native sql mssql LIKE", "service-analytics COLLATE" → none.
Blocked-by: #31327
Reader: the epic PM dispatches it after #31327 lands.
type: Bug

## 维护者速读

- **问题：** SQL Server 联邦对象上，driver-sql 的文本匹配已按 #6518 区分「大小写精确」和「忽略大小写」两种（用 BIN2 排序规则）。但仪表盘走的 service-analytics 原生 SQL 那条路径仍然生成普通 `LIKE`，结果跟随库的默认排序规则，和同一个过滤条件在列表页的结果可能不一致。Oracle 是否有同样的问题需要一起测一下。
- **需要您做的：** 无。

## Task

- [ ] Measure first: the same text filter through the driver face and through service-analytics' native-SQL face, on a case-insensitive SQL Server collation, gives different rows. Measure Oracle the same way.
- [ ] Make the native-SQL face emit the dialect's text-match arms. Reuse driver-sql's emitters; don't copy them.
- [ ] Pin it: compile-level for every arm, and a live cell when a URL is present.

`Clause-②: no` expected · `Metadata-protocol: none`.
